acceptanceCriteria: cargo fmt --check, cargo check --workspace, cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings, cargo test --workspace all pass; scheduled-seven-day-life's stdout contains Day 1 through Day 5 but not Day 6 or Day 7, plus a message noting the safety cap stopped it and that no progress persists between runs; the log file under std::env::temp_dir() contains matching content; phase_12_scheduler.rs directly asserts both StopReason::MaxCyclesReached and StopReason::ScriptExhausted; bash tests/architecture/check-boundaries.sh passes; existing seven-day-life/multiple-individuals/multiple-goods subcommands and tests remain unchanged
goal: goods_runtime::scheduler::{ScheduledCycle, StopReason, run_scheduled} are implemented, not generic over ObservationSource/HumanFeedbackSource (concrete DemoObservationSource/DemoHumanFeedbackSource only); a new apps/goods-garden-cli scheduled-seven-day-life subcommand reuses the existing SEVEN_DAY_SCRIPT data, runs with max_cycles=5 (deliberately less than the 7-day script) to demonstrate the safety cap independently stopping mid-script, writes the same output to both stdout and a log file under std::env::temp_dir(), and prints the log file path; a new phase_12_scheduler.rs test verifies both StopReason cases directly and verifies the CLI's stdout/log-file behavior; existing run_seven_day_life/multiple-individuals/multiple-goods subcommands and their tests are unchanged; Japanese-only phase doc and design spec are added recording the four guardrails as confirmed Human Decisions; domain-model.md/glossary.md/README.md's Japanese sections are updated (English/Chinese sections stay untouched at Phase 1).
intent: Implement the Phase 0 scheduler placeholder in goods-runtime as a bounded, foreground-only, type-level-synthetic-only autonomous driver (goods_runtime::scheduler::run_scheduled) for the Intelligence Loop, per four Human Decision guardrails confirmed with the repository owner: synthetic-only enforced at the type level, a hard max-cycles safety cap, durable audit logging to a file in addition to stdout, and foreground-only (no daemonization).
outOfScope: real ObservationSource/HumanFeedbackSource adapters or any generic parameterization of the scheduler over them
persistence of domain state (goods-domain's MemoryStore remains an empty placeholder)
English and Chinese sections of domain-model.md/glossary.md/README.md
